crossRefs.note: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort;
who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the…
Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge…
In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned…
“I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who…
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…
to proclaim the year of Yahweh’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,
Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance; the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy…
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ…
If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any…
Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through…
comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus, my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into…
I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you…
But when Timothy came just now to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good…
for this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.
Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

people.name: Titus

translations.web: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
translations.bsb: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the arrival of Titus,
translations.kjv: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
translations.asv: Nevertheless he that comforteth the lowly, even God, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
